quote: Surround yourself with relentless humans. People who plan in decades, but live in moments. Train like savages, but create like artists. Obsess in work, relax in life. People who know this is finite, and choose to play infinite games. Find people scaling mountains. Climb together.
author: Zack Pogrob

quote: The questions you ask yourself will largely determine the answers you get.
author: Julie Gurner

quote: If you always do what you’ve always done, you’ll always get what you’ve always got.
author: Henry Ford

quote: Your success... or mediocrity... or failure... is simply a reflection of your thinking.
author: Doug Firebaugh

quote: Worrying does not empty tomorrow of its troubles, it empties today of its strength.
author: Corrie Ten Boom

quote: Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body and prayer is to the soul. We become the books we read.
author: Matthew Kelly

quote: A positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events and outcomes. It is a catalyst and it sparks extraordinary results.
author: Wade Boggs

quote: Love people, use things. The opposite never works.
author: Joshua Fields Millburn

quote: Never offer what you'd hate someone for accepting.
author: Tara Ploughman

quote: Tolerant with others, strict with yourself.
author: Marcus Aurelius

quote: To achieve excellence, we must first understand the reality of every day, with all its demands and potential frustrations.
author: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi

quote: It is impossible to produce superior performance, unless you do something different from the majority.
author: Sir John Templeton
